title: Cut rank-two clean compilation from 16 to 10 CNOTs (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic construction with exact finite corroboration. Shared scalar conjugators lower the canonical rank-two clean square-zero compiler from sixteen to ten CNOTs, retaining three coordinate reflections and the exact clean return.

```diff
- specified clean bill: 3R + 16C + H
+ specified clean bill: 3R + 10C + H
  specified dirty bill: 4R +  4C
```

The new clean stream beats the specified dirty stream exactly when `R > 6C+H`, improving the previous `R > 12C+H` comparison. This answers the scalar-sharing handoff in Open next question 2 of JoyboyBrian's merged #5007. Its construction and reflection-call minimum are cited, not audited or replayed. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. No scalar-network optimum, new kappa or supplier admission is claimed.

For arbitrary data `a,b,c,d` and linear involution g in characteristic two, the full formal endpoint is `(a+c+g(c), b+d+g(d), c, d, g(h))`. A zero helper therefore returns exactly to zero. The written proof derives the new stream and independently tracks all five inputs. Every scalar addition and inverse operation is counted.

Credit JoyboyBrian #5007 for the clean construction and open question; Nick Petalas #4912 for the dirty optimum and compiler; ywz65 #2716 for the involution-product identity; Adam Gall #1911 and the retained register-model lineage. Only seven files in the new `research/clean-rank-two-conjugators/` package are added.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19213538).

## Evidence

- The complete new endpoint passes coefficientwise over formal F2[C2]. A separate literal bit-array interpreter passes all 1,024 two-address states, including all 256 clean-helper states, plus 3,215 complete basis columns for all 119 involutory permutations on one through six addresses.
- All thirteen individual primitive omissions reject. Controls also expose the arbitrary-dirty-helper substitution, a noninvolutory address substitution and a changed noncommuting order. The finite checks corroborate the written uniform identity.
- Both warning-strict registered commands pass locally under CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64, standard library only. Timed direct commands took 0.0452 s normal and 0.0432 s optimized, rounded upward. These are check durations, not performance claims.
- The registered package runner, syntax inspection, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight, official ten-file committed export and export integrity pass on head `b313bad5735ebaa9e303b9813a29d949917e2c76`.
- Both direct commands pass from a read-only, Git-free export with empty PATH. All eleven exported files, including the export manifest, retain their bytes.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/clean-rank-two-conjugators/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/clean-rank-two-conjugators/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clean-rank-two-conjugators
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clean-rank-two-conjugators --check-source-history
```

Substitute another CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. Expected markers include `PASS_CLEAN_RANK_TWO_CONJUGATORS reflections=3 CNOTs=10 no_new_kappa`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The verifier writes no files and emits a generated receipt bound to all package and cited-input hashes.

Canonical main was refreshed before committing and remains `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. The selected source-binding orientation passes after sparse materialization. The overlap helper paginated 405 open PRs and 5,290 Discussion records; its sparse local coverage is incomplete. Distinctive searches of main's full README tree, merged PRs, relevant live bodies and fresh claims found no competing ten-CNOT result. Unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain coverage limits.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The new result prices specified literal words. Neither scalar stream is claimed globally optimal. Reflection, CNOT and clean-resource prices must include their complete stationary implementation costs; none is supplied here. Common data-basis transport must be charged equally on both sides. A general dirty helper is not restored.

Native suppliers, physical routing/frames/tapes/hosting, clean-resource availability, recursive admission and the complete multiplication theorem remain open. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker, selected scientific replay and predecessor executables were not run. Every registered local command passed.

## Open next questions

Can a literal native rank-two caller supply complete prices satisfying `R > 6C+H`? First bind all data movement, inverse scalar maps, reflection work and clean reservation/return to actual operations. Missing native contracts and a complete caller invoice are the blockers. No further rank or scalar-optimality search is included.

## Related open work

- #5854 studies split determinants and reachability over a multi-generator square-zero radical algebra. Its zero-residue target and paid alphabet differ from this fixed-involution literal compiler; no common minimum is compared.
- #5856 proves an asymmetric UT3 block-call tariff gap with two noncommuting address labels. This package counts CNOTs in a specified one-involution clean compiler; no common numerical quantity is compared.
- #5861 proves right-vector factorization costs over products of local algebras. Its paid factors and scalar-cost convention differ from the literal coordinate-reflection/CNOT stream here; it does not determine this compiler's scalar count.

Completion refresh inspected this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, #5854 through #5862. The other submissions concern symplectic completion, Hermitian commuting repair, inverse norms, binary-header association and unitary-cycle conditioning. None computes this fixed-involution compiler's CNOT count, and no disagreement in a shared computed quantity was found. No predecessor or peer mathematical executable was run. Merged #5007 and #4912 remain the direct predecessors.

## CI notes

On contribution commit `b313bad5735ebaa9e303b9813a29d949917e2c76`, [run 40479306439](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40479306439) completed with **plan failed; replay skipped**. The only failed step is [Onboarding helper tests](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40479306439/job/122105303546).

Its command is `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py' -v`. All ten failure/error records are in unchanged `tests/test_research_current_assignment.py`; the summary is `FAILED (failures=8, errors=2, skipped=22)` after 511 tests. The errors are `KeyError: 'follow_up_steps'` and `KeyError: 'catalog_first_step'`. The eight failures concern missing expected current-assignment resolution/validation, including `0 != 16`, expected ValueErrors not raised and empty resolved-path lists. This matches the known main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a` failure. [PR #5854's run 40478863245](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40478863245) independently shows the same ten failure names and the same eight-failure/two-error summary.

The [registered package replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40479306439/job/122107083858) was **skipped**. Hosted replay has not certified this package; only the local scientific checks, registered normal/optimized commands, committed-byte/source-history preflight and Git-free export checks described above have run. Shared tests and implementation are left unchanged for the maintainer repair. No additional commit was made during this CI handoff.

## Merge danger

**Blast radius:** isolated.

One new opt-in research package. Shared implementations, frozen predecessors and the selected result are unchanged.
